hypothesis: Current grouping merges equal nonzero scalars only. Opposite scalar classes could share a signed point sum before windowing. Measure opportunity in actual fresh A/B query scalars before implementing curve changes.
scope: Accepted current libraries and solver, nine supplied raw keys/fixtures, A_G1 and B_G2 plus rawK diagnostic. No candidate prover, new proof, timing gain, key rewrite or retained table. RawK is not accepted foldedK/EulerH work and must not be represented as that hot path.
method: For each freshly solved vector compare exact nonzero equality classes with classes modulo sign, using canonical integer p-x with independent field negation check. Count only class reductions beyond existing equality grouping, opposite-present classes and affected original rows. Each scalar is reconstructed from representative and sign, and two independent deterministic weighted-Fr linear functional checks validate signed regrouping. Do not export witness/scalar values.
decision: If no opposite classes, close without implementation. Otherwise report exact savings fraction without a speed prediction and assess maximal affected point work versus overhead before any separately declared curve trial. No arbitrary minimum-positive-gain floor or retrospective threshold.
validation: Synthetic zero/one/minusone/random/cancellation/duplicates, independent integer negation, full field weighted reconstructions, source/library/key/fixture pins before/after. Both rawkey and artifact solver-image outputs must agree if a cached image is used. No external implementation copied.
limitations: One established fixture per shape; counts cannot prove input-independent absence or native latency, and equal-only grouping sampling/admission may differ by shape. No minimum RAM or mobile result.
